text:
Kai: quick heads-up 1 seeing a weird console artifact after yesterday's routing roll: lots of tiny back-to-back sessions on reconnects that look like duplicate charges.
Isha: I noticed a support ticket too. is this the half-close change or something else?
Kai: i traced one: client closes cleanly, proxy returns 1000, client reconnects immediately, new route claims while backend still finishing a chunk. billing records two claims ~300ms apart.
Brett: paste logs?
Kai: ```
[proxy] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.000 route-claim client=usr-44 shard=eu-west ttl=60ms
[backend] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.120 finishing-chunk client=usr-44 seq=512
[proxy] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.180 client-close code=1000 client=usr-44
[client] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.190 reconnect client=usr-44 shard=eu-west-2
[billing] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.210 charge-start session=usr-44
[billing] 2026-04-05T08:45:01.520 charge-start session=usr-44.v2
```
Isha: billing starts on claim as expected. overlapping claims look like two active sessions to console and ops.
Brett: are SSE-only? or WS too?
Kai: mostly SSE; a few WS-multiplex flows hit it. SSE reconnections often lack Last-Event-ID header so console dedupe can't match.
Isha: possible causes: reduced affinity TTL + immediate reconnects + backend chunk flush delay. when chunk flushes are longer than the tombstone window we get the overlap.
Brett: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) revert affinity TTL in canary, 2) bias proxy to wait up to X ms for in-flight chunk flush before granting route claim, 3) console UI: hide/annotate overlaps shorter than 500ms.
Kai: prefer (1) for immediate safety, and (2) as the long-term fix. (3) reduces support noise but masks signal.
Isha: agree. also we should add a billing idempotency heuristic: if second claim is for the same client fingerprint within 1s, defer duplicate charge or link them. but need to avoid masking real dual-connections.
Brett: fingerprint idea: hash(client-id + low-res IP + user-agent) as a soft key. coarse but reduces false positives on NAT. complement with Last-Event-ID equality when present.
Kai: telemetry: request new metric claim_vs_chunk_flush_ms and histogram of overlap durations. console panel "probable-route-swap" to show traces for overlaps <1s.
Isha: i'll add dashboard cards and an alert if overlap rate >0.25% in a 5m window.
monitor-bot: alert: route-claim-overlap rate exceeded 0.3% at 08:50 UTC; sampling enabled.
Brett: sampling: capture headers for affected reconnects (Last-Event-ID if present, UA, ephemeral client id) so SDK teams can be notified.
Kai: sdk teams should also encourage sending Last-Event-ID consistently on SSE reconnects; that will make dedupe deterministic.
Isha: rollout plan: revert affinity TTL on canary now, patch proxy drain to prefer flushing for up to 500ms, and ship console hide/annotation for short overlaps this afternoon. open RFC for billing idempotency window.
deploy-bot: canary rollback initiated by Isha at 08:56 UTC.
Brett: follow-ups: METR-901 add claim_vs_chunk_flush metric + dashboard, INFRA-2392 proxy-drain-flush patch, BILL-417 idempotent-charge RFC, SDK-122 doc update for Last-Event-ID.
Kai: also add a small unit/integration test in streaming-harness that does immediate reconnects with half-close + inflight-chunk to prevent regressions.
Isha: will schedule a 30m sync after rollback to review traces. thanks all. :thumbsup:
